title: DataAccuracy
description: ISO 25012-sourced data quality archetype — Accuracy inherent data quality characteristic. The degree to which data has attributes that correctly represent the true value of the intended attribute of a concept or event in a specific context of use. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms governing data entities. Source: ISO/IEC 25012 (Inherent Data Quality — Accuracy).

accuracyLevel.description: Classification of required data accuracy. APPROXIMATE = rough values acceptable. ACCEPTABLE = within defined tolerance. PRECISE = high fidelity required. EXACT = no deviation permitted.

tolerancePercent.description: Maximum acceptable deviation from true value, expressed as percentage.

validationMethod.description: Method used to validate data accuracy against ground truth.
